definition: Plug & Pray is a 2010 documentary film about the promise, problems and ethics of artificial intelligence and robotics.
details: The main protagonists are the former MIT professor Joseph Weizenbaum and the futurist Raymond Kurzweil. The title is a pun on the computer hardware phrase "Plug and Play".
